title: A molecular absorption line survey towards the AGN of Hydra-A
question: What molecular species and cloud properties are revealed by multi-line molecular absorption against the Hydra-A AGN, and does the absorption vary over two years?

what.value: X-ray line-of-sight column density N_H = 3.5e22 cm^-2

evidence.quote: (cite: Russell2013) find a line of sight column density of $N_{H} = 3.5 \times 10^{22} \textnormal{cm}^{-2}$ from X-ray observations.

what.value: 2016 CO(2-1) absorption observation used for variability comparison

evidence.quote: CO(2-1) absorption was first detected in Hydra-A in October 2016 (cite: Rose2019a)

recipe.method: Channel maps at maximal spectral resolution; spectra extracted from a beam-sized region at the continuum source
Gaussian fit to broad emission with absorption velocities (-50 to +10 km/s) masked
Common 12-Gaussian fit with fixed sigma and vcen across spectra, free non-positive amplitudes
key_parameters: initial 10 Gaussians from CO(2-1), HCO+(2-1), HCN(2-1); two added after >5 sigma residuals

assumptions: covering factor 0.7 for G2, 1 for others

recipe.method: Tex from HCO+ (1-0)/(2-1) integrated tau ratio; Tkin = 10 x I(HCN)/I(HNC)
Optically thin N with optical-depth correction tau/(1-exp(-tau)); Larson sigma-D relation; virial mass M=D sigma^2/2G
assumptions: Milky Way sigma=D^0.5 relation holds; virial equilibrium

evidence.quote: The minimum number of Gaussians required to provide a good fit for all of the lines is found to be 12.
This gives an excitation temperature of 5.5$^{+ 2.0 }_{- 1.6 }$ K
5.8$^{+ 0.7 }_{- 0.7}$ K when the same method is applied
The total mass inferred from the molecular absorption seen in Hydra-A is $4\times 10 ^{4} M_{\odot}$
Hydra-A’s central continuum source has an apparent diameter of 7 pc

not_stated_but_needed: tclean/imaging parameters (weighting, robust, cell, image size, continuum subtraction, line-free channels)
Continuum RMS used and how continuum level extracted
Flux calibrators and flux scale uncertainty
Partition functions, Einstein A values and spectroscopic database used
How the 2016 and 2018 data were matched in resolution for variability test
Exact fitting algorithm/software for Gaussian fits
score_reason: Public ALMA data and clear spectral analysis, but imaging settings and fitting details missing.
rediscovery_reason: Data public, spectra analysis recipe largely given with numeric tables of tau and N.
